builds.note: Controller line 2 shows robot battery, controller battery and the hottest motor (B80% C90% T45C), and turns into HOT with the motor's port at 55 C or more. Auto-grab works at any lift height (it will also close on a Goal or wall that comes within 75 mm). New routine Calibrate: all sensors (Calib all, last in the list): drops and zeroes the lift, recalibrates the IMU, zeroes the tracking wheels, then shows which sensors answered. Autons as 417. Not run on a robot yet.

Driver fixes: auto-grab works with the lift within about 0.5 in of the bottom (was about 0.15 in); the reset (R2) always finishes, within 0.5 in of the bottom or after 1.5 s, so the claw can no longer stay locked out after a reset that stopped short; cascade motors on hold (Build 420 tried brake and was worse, skip 420). Autons as 417. Not run on a robot yet.

Match auton as on 414 (lift string slack guard, slows down sooner before the second Cup and Pin) with Skills exactly as on 408. Skills opens with the match route, so 411 and 414 had changed its opening too; this build switches those changes off for Skills, which means Skills has no slack guard. Not run on a robot yet.

Match AWP slows down sooner before the second Cup and Pin: it is at creep speed 6 in out instead of 4 (it still drove in too fast on some runs). Costs about 0.1 s. Includes the 411 slack guard. Not run on a robot yet.

Slack guard for the lift string: the second score lowers the stack to 190 instead of 106 (the Cup sits on the Pin at 205, measured), and after any stack drop the open claw stops at 45 instead of 0 until the robot has backed out (it rests at 60, measured). Match AWP and the Skills opening. The third score has no measured height yet. Not run on a robot yet.

Skills round 2: at the second Toggle it keeps a light push on the wall and keeps trying for 3 s (it left after 1 s with the Toggle still yellow); drives onto the Loader faster and farther, waits for the load, then closes the claw even if the sensor never sees it; the legs to and from the Toggle skip their turn trims and stop-and-creep. Match AWP unchanged. Not run on a robot yet.

Skills fixes from the 402 recording: goes wider round the side alliance Goal on the way to Toggle 2 (it was hitting it), legs slow down more gently so they stop on their spots without creeping back (about 0.75 s saved per leg), and squares up after the Loader Pin drop so the route no longer ends at 45 s. Loader grab not changed. Match AWP unchanged. Not run on a robot yet.

Skills now opens with the pre-match auton's three scores (the same route, on the 60 s clock), then carries on to Toggle 2 and the Loader trips as before. Match AWP unchanged from 399. Not run on a robot yet; the legs after the opening have never completed on the robot.

Three-score match AWP test: the third drop is one Pin lower (carries at 655, lets go at 495; 396 let go at 730, far too high). Everything else as 396, which reached the Goal with the third stack in time. Safety build is still 390. Not run on a robot yet.

TEST 2, not the safety build (that is 390). Match AWP speed test: square turns hand over a little earlier still (18 deg) so the first Pin and step 3 turns should not need a trim, and no stop wait before the square turns. About 1.2 s more cut on paper; the third score lands at about 15 s. Not run on a robot yet.

TEST, not the safety build (that is 390). Match AWP speed test for the third score: first Pin drive out no longer stops and creeps back, square turns hand over earlier so they should not need a trim, shorter wait on the seated first Pin, no stop wait before the short stage drives. About 3 s cut on paper. Watch the first Pin. Not run on a robot yet.

Safety build: the match AWP creeps a little slower onto the second Cup and Pin (inner stack), power 26 instead of 30 for the last few inches. Everything else as 387: Toggle holds our color 0.10 s, sideways odometry wheel not used, first Pin from the Skills opening. Not run on a robot yet.

Start Toggle made safe again: our color has to hold 0.10 s before the auton drives off (384 had no wait and left the Toggle on the wrong color twice). Everything else as 384: sideways odometry wheel not used, first Pin from the Skills opening. Not run on a robot yet.

Fixes the position going wrong on every turn: the new sideways odometry wheel read backwards (the 11-12 recording shows the position jumping about 10 in during the first turn), so it is no longer used and the robot is back on the forward wheel and the IMU. Start Toggle no longer waits 0.15 s before driving off. First Pin as in 379. Not run on a robot yet.

Match AWP first Pin now uses the exact Skills first-Pin moves (straight out, braked square turn, straight push), on both sides. After a stack grab the lift rises about half an inch before the robot drives off, in the match AWP and Skills. First Pin is a little slower, so the third score may not fit in 15 s. Not run on a robot yet; run the right side once before a match. Fall back to 374 for the old opening.

Wall distance sensors set from the wall readings: port 4 is the right sensor and 14 the left (they were swapped), offsets from 240 / 145 / 20 / 20 mm. Still checks only: brain line 7 shows LocS during an auton and driving is unchanged. Includes the 371 sideways wheel offset and the 368 lift fix. Not run on a robot yet.

Sideways odometry wheel offset set to the taped 4 7/8 in behind the turning center (was a 4.5 in guess), so turns fake less sideways slide. Everything else as 368, including the lift fix. Not run on a robot yet; still check that pushing the robot left makes H go up.

Lift fix for autons: the lift no longer risks stopping a few degrees off its height (and the route giving up after a 3 s wait) when it gets a new height while still moving, like the lower to the floor before a stack grab. Routes, speeds and heights unchanged from 365. Not run on a robot yet; if the lift acts up, go back to 365.
Wall distance sensors (ports 1, 12, 4, 14) on as checks only: while an auton runs, brain line 7 shows LocS with how far the wall estimate is from odometry. Driving unchanged. Not run on a robot yet.
Reset moved to R2 (D-pad Left does nothing now). After the claw auto-grabs a Pin or Cup + Pin, the lift rises about half an inch by itself. Lift heights unchanged. Not run on a robot yet.
Neutral Goal heights 275, 565, 780, 1010, 1190 (teammate measured). Also has the slower radio send and the 7/16 in spool alliance heights. Not run on a robot yet.

Sending a session to the laptop over the controller radio no longer drops rows: rows go out 60 ms apart (a 15 s run takes about 17 s to send, Skills about 70 s; wait for SENT before stopping the recording). Includes the 7/16 in spool lift heights. Not run on a robot yet.

Lift heights for the new 7/16 in spool: alliance 185 to 1140 as measured, neutral 300, 385 measured and 600, 815 estimated; auton lift numbers scaled to match. Auto-grab 75 mm. Not run on a robot yet.
Claw auto-grab at 75 mm (was 65). Lift heights are not updated for the new smaller spool yet, so presets stop low. Not run on a robot yet.

Claw never tilts down: D-pad Up does nothing, push the preload into the open claw at the bottom, auton start no longer lifts and tilts. Solo AWP and Skills Loader grabs use the tilted-up claw. Not run on a robot yet.

Hardware update: intake removed (R1/R2 do nothing), cascade on 3 green motors (twice as fast), lift height from the new spool sensor, new sideways odometry wheel, claw auto-grab at 65 mm. Run the tester's Lift directions first.
Adds a wall-distance position filter, switched off until the sensors are mounted. Robot behavior unchanged.
AWP: stack drops exactly square, clamp wait back to 250 ms. Skills rebuilt in straight lines. Route Map prediction corrected
RECF: right Goal + roller, preload aimed 0.6 in left
AWP: 2nd cup and pin lowered onto the 1st, LEDs on
AWP: faster first Pin, driver heading hold fix
